description: Determine whether ONE candidate person is the taxpayer's § 152 dependent — qualifying child or qualifying relative, including multiple-support agreements and the divorced-parents release — as a proof-backed yes/no with citations. Feed the result into calculate_tax's credits group (qualifyingChildren / otherDependents).

asOf.description: REQUIRED for computation: the law-in-force date — use the intended tax year's year-end (e.g. "2025-12-31" for TY2025). Omitting it is an error, never a default.

custodialParentReleasedClaim.description: The custodial parent signed a written declaration (Form 8332) releasing the claim to the child for this year (§ 152(e)(2)).

depAge.description: Candidate's age at the end of the year (§ 152(c)(3)).

depDivorcedParentsRule.description: § 152(e) applies to the candidate child: the parents are divorced, separated, or lived apart the last 6 months of the year; the child received over half their support from the parents and was in their custody over half the year.

depFilesJointReturn.description: Candidate files a joint return with a spouse (other than a refund-only claim) (§ 152(c)(1)(E)).

depGrossIncome.description: Candidate's gross income for the year (§ 152(d)(1)(B) limit: $5,200 TY2025 / $5,300 TY2026). In dollars.

depIsFullTimeStudent.description: Candidate was a full-time student for at least 5 months (§ 152(f)(2)).

depIsQualifyingChildOfAnother.description: Candidate is the qualifying child of the taxpayer or any other taxpayer (§ 152(d)(1)(D)).

depLivedWithTaxpayerOverHalfYear.description: Candidate had the same principal residence as the taxpayer for more than half the year (§ 152(c)(1)(B)).

depPermanentlyDisabled.description: Candidate is permanently and totally disabled (§ 152(c)(3)(B)).

depProvidedOwnSupportOverHalf.description: Candidate provided more than half of their own support (§ 152(c)(1)(D)).

depRelationshipChild.description: Candidate is the taxpayer's child, stepchild, foster child, sibling, step-sibling, or a descendant of any of them (§ 152(c)(2)).

depRelationshipRelative.description: Candidate bears a § 152(d)(2) relationship to the taxpayer (parent, grandparent, sibling, in-law, etc.) or lived in the household all year.

depYoungerThanTaxpayer.description: Candidate is younger than the taxpayer (§ 152(c)(3)(A)).

hasMultipleSupportAgreement.description: A § 152(d)(3) multiple-support agreement is in place for the candidate: the group together provided over half the support, no one person provided over half, each member could otherwise claim the candidate, and every other over-10% contributor signed a Form 2120 waiver.

target.description: rule to derive (default: us.federal.dependent.is_dependent). Other targets: us.federal.dependent.qualifying_child, us.federal.dependent.qualifying_relative

taxpayerIsCustodialParent.description: The taxpayer is the custodial parent (the parent with whom the child resided the greater number of nights, § 152(e)(4)(A)).

taxpayerProvidedOver10PercentSupport.description: The taxpayer contributed over 10 percent of the candidate's support (§ 152(d)(3)(D) — the support test under a multiple-support agreement).

taxpayerProvidedOverHalfSupport.description: The taxpayer provided more than half of the candidate's support (§ 152(d)(1)(C)).

name: determine_dependent
